name: sarama-deterministic-broker-exchange-capture-6934
instr:
Sarama cannot capture bounded, deterministic broker exchange transcripts or replay them offline without contacting Kafka. Add both. Replayed metadata, produce, and SASL handshake exchanges must match live results for existing consumers. Without capture or replay, behavior stays unchanged.

Record each Broker exchange once at its terminal boundary, in correlation order, with an immutable snapshot and one unambiguous ExchangeOutcome. Bounds must exhaust deterministically without partial records, altered request results, or changed earlier snapshots. Typed MetadataResponse, ProduceResponse, and SaslHandshakeResponse records must preserve every value supported by their version and restore only for the matching API and version.

ExchangeReplayer must consume matching records atomically without dialing. ReplayMismatchError must leave mismatched records available. NewExchangeRecorder(maxRecords, maxBytes) returns an ExchangeRecorder with an isolated Snapshot(); NewExchangeReplayer(transcript) returns an ordered *ExchangeReplayer. Config.ExchangeCapture must reject negative bounds or simultaneous recording and replay before connection work; its zero value is inert. NewBroker(addr), Broker.ExchangeTranscript(), MockBroker.SetExchangeRecorder(recorder), and MockBroker.SetExchangeReplay(replayer) must follow the same transcript rules while preserving request-sensitive mock behavior and existing ownership, closure, cache, retry, authentication, and error presentation.
